sequential_dependency.intermediate: The completed occupied macro-cell set, including the newly inserted copies of the special tile.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Decode the unique novel-color micro-mask, align it uniquely to the observed special tiles, and complete its macro-scale copy.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Flood the complement of that completed set from the macro-grid boundary using four-neighbor connectivity, and fill the enclosed macro-cells with the special tile.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Missing boundary tiles can leave a cavity open. Flooding the partial arrangement first classifies it as exterior and misses a pocket closed only by template completion.
